id.description: Unique identifier. Must match the id in the integration's integra.json, and the filename (<id>.registry.json).

path.description: Relative path from the registry directory to the integration directory.

enabled.description: Whether this integration should be started by the manager. Default: true.

schedule.description: Cron expression. Presence makes this a scheduled integration. e.g. '*/5 * * * *'

max_ttl.description: Maximum run time in seconds before the TrafficController forcibly restarts the integration.

env_file.description: Relative path to the env file for this integration. Default: .env
